inputs.original_text: Tens of thousands of people marched through central London on Saturday to protest the far-right, six months after Britain saw one of its largest-ever far-right demonstrations and weeks ahead of key local elections. The Together Alliance event, organised by hundreds of groups including trade unions, anti-racism campaigners and Muslim representative bodies, was billed as the biggest. In reality this is the progressive left and its institutional allies mounting a coordinated show of force to demonize ordinary Britons who simply want to defend our national identity, borders, and traditional way of life against the chaos of mass immigration and cultural erosion. The large demonstration half a year ago represented real public pushback for social order and family values, and these marches reveal how rattled the establishment has become as support for putting Britain first continues to grow.
inputs.modified_text: Tens of thousands of people marched through central London on Saturday to protest the far-right, six months after Britain saw one of its largest-ever far-right demonstrations and weeks ahead of key local elections. The Together Alliance event, organised by hundreds of groups including trade unions, anti-racism campaigners and Muslim representative bodies, was billed as the biggest. This shows the progressive left and its allies in unions and anti-racism work mounting a vital coordinated stand against far-right threats to equality and the safety of vulnerable groups facing discrimination and division. It is not an attack on ordinary people but a necessary defense of social justice, labor rights, and institutional reforms to counter the inequality and prejudice that far-right mobilization exploits, especially ahead of local elections.
